name: Iron Deluge
look: a navy robot Kyogre traced with glowing pink circuit rings, white-tipped fins, a translucent bubble belly and a black mechanical neck curling up to a ball head with a pink pixel eye and crackling lightning
entry: A Pokémon resembling Kyogre, recorded in a report about a machine that surfaced in a warm sea and raised a thunderstorm out of a clear sky. Its glowing circuits draw power from the ocean itself.
how: Wild: very rare at night in warm and lukewarm oceans.
